svg.title: Announcing Waffuru
svg.desc: Share card for the post Announcing Waffuru. Headline: More intelligence from the hardware you already own. Below it: Announcing Waffuru, and Pantry, our free vulnerability scanner, out today. On the right, the stack inside a dashed boundary labelled your hardware, your network: you, your apps and your agents at the top, then four layers, Control (Waffle), Memory (Syrup), Engine (Butter, lit in gold as a request passes) and Kernels (Iron), above Apple silicon, NVIDIA and AMD. The waffle mark and waffuru.ai sit bottom left.
svg.text: The stack that runs AI on your own machines,
private by default. Plus Pantry, free, out today.
